mapper.select: SELECT ND.* FROM TIMESHEET TM INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_NOTE WEN ON WEN.WORK_EFFORT_ID = TM.WORK_EFFORT_ID AND WEN.SEQUENCE_ID = 10 INNER JOIN NOTE_DATA ND ON ND.NOTE_ID = WEN.NOTE_ID WHERE TM.TIMESHEET_ID = #{userLoginId}
select nd.* from party_note pn join note_data nd ON pn.note_id = nd.note_id where pn.party_id = #{prefValue} and nd.note_name = 'APPLICATION_TITLE'
